description: This file implements the ActiveRequests class and its nested ActiveRequestsData class, managing media request segments, including adding, erasing, and retrieving segments, as well as handling request lifecycle within a media server context.

classes.name: ActiveRequests::ActiveRequestsData
classes.description: Manages individual media segments for a specific request, including adding segments and cleanup.

classes.name: ActiveRequests
classes.description: Manages multiple media requests, allowing insertion, removal, and segment management for each request.

methods.name: ActiveRequests::ActiveRequestsData::~ActiveRequestsData
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up allocated segment data.

methods.name: ActiveRequests::ActiveRequestsData::addSegment
methods.description: Adds a media segment to the request if there is enough space.

methods.name: ActiveRequests::insert
methods.description: Inserts a new media request with specified source type and max media bytes, returning a request ID.

methods.name: ActiveRequests::getType
methods.description: Retrieves the media source type for a given request ID.

methods.name: ActiveRequests::erase
methods.description: Removes a request by its ID.

methods.name: ActiveRequests::erase
methods.description: Removes all requests matching a specific media source type.

methods.name: ActiveRequests::addSegment
methods.description: Adds a media segment to a specific request by ID.

methods.name: ActiveRequests::getSegments
methods.description: Retrieves all segments associated with a specific request ID.
